rules.text: Online purchases must be returned within 40 days of order date.
rules.quote: Online purchases must be returned within 40 days of order date.

rules.text: Store purchases must be returned within 40 days of purchase.
rules.quote: Store purchases must be returned within 40 days of purchase.

rules.text: Returns must be accompanied by the receipt.
Beauty products must be unopened and may only be returned in-store.
rules.quote: Beauty products must be unopened and may only be returned in-store.

rules.text: Car seats must be returned unopened in original box with unbroken seals; returns with broken seals are not accepted.
rules.quote: Car seats must be returned in the original, unopened box. Car seat boxes come with unbroken seals to ensure the item is brand-new. We will not accept returns with a broken seal.

rules.text: Fine jewelry and designer items purchased at Nordstrom or Nordstrom.com are not eligible to be returned to Nordstrom Rack stores or by mail.
rules.quote: Fine jewelry and designer items purchased at Nordstrom or [Nordstrom.com](https://www.nordstrom.com/) are not eligible to be returned to Nordstrom Rack stores or by mail.

rules.text: A returns shipping charge of $9.95 will be deducted from your refund per pre-paid shipping label used for mail returns.
rules.quote: A returns shipping charge of $9.95 will be deducted from your refund per pre-paid shipping label used.

rules.text: Eligible returns will be credited to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: Eligible returns will be credited to original form of payment.

rules.text: Refunds for gifts will be issued as a Nordstrom Gift Card redeemable online and in store at Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack.
rules.quote: Refunds for gifts will be issued as a Nordstrom Gift Card, redeemable online and in store at Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack.

rules.text: Refunds to credit cards may appear within 3–5 business days depending on the financial institution.
rules.quote: If you've paid with a credit card, depending on your financial institution, you may see that refund within 3–5 business days.

rules.text: Online and store purchases may be exchanged in store; exchanges by mail are not provided.
rules.quote: Online and store purchases may be exchanged in store. Sorry, we do not provide an exchange option by mail at this time.
